correctness.rationale: For ordered S5 partitions E,F on n>=1 worlds, S(A)=box_E A union box_F A preserves meets iff for every w the cells E[w],F[w] are nested: incomparable cells violate meet preservation at A=E[w],B=F[w], while nested cells give S=box_(E∩F). The bipartite incidence graph then has each edge with a leaf endpoint, so each join component is a star, i.e., E or F indiscrete locally. A join block of size m has 2B_m-1 connected structures, giving labelled EGF exp(2exp(e^z-1)-e^z-1) and L_n=Σ_j C(n-1,j-1)(2B_j-1)L_(n-j); unlabeled connected types 2p(m)-1 give ∏_(m>=1)(1-z^m)^-(2p(m)-1). Globally comparable count 2H_n-B_n, so local/global gap first n=4 with six ordered pairs. Independent enumeration of all ordered set partition pairs through n=6 recovered L=1,4,19,111,774,6229, and independent simultaneous-relabeling orbits through n=5 recovered 1,4,9,24,52. General result follows from the exponential/multiset argument, not enumeration.
residual_risks: Finite tests cannot prove all-parameter claim; proof reconstruction establishes stated scope.
